# devkitPro portlibs that the Vulkan-only release build links against.
#
# This file is the cache key for the portlibs archive (see the "Restore the
# cached devkitPro portlibs" step in release-vulkan.yml), so editing it
# invalidates the cache. Keep it to what the build actually needs:
#
#   emulator (Makefile, RENDERER=VK + MESA_FLAVOR=nxvk)
#     LIBS = $(NXVK_LIBS) $(STORAGE_LIBS) -lcurl -lz -lnx -lstdc++ -lm
#     -> switch-curl, switch-zlib, switch-ntfs-3g (libntfs-3g.a)
#     -> switch-expat via nxvk.pc (-lexpat), handled by its own step because
#        the package name is not guaranteed to exist
#   launcher (launcher/Makefile)
#     LIBS = $(STORAGE_LIBS) $(pkg-config SDL2...) -lturbojpeg -lz -lGLESv2 -lnx
#     -> switch-sdl2*, switch-libjpeg-turbo, switch-mesa (-lGLESv2)
#
# devkitA64 / libnx / switch-tools are NOT listed: the devkitpro/devkita64
# container image already provides them, and the workflow checks for them
# instead of asking pacman over the network.
switch-mesa
switch-curl
switch-zlib
switch-ntfs-3g
switch-sdl2
switch-sdl2_ttf
switch-sdl2_image
switch-libjpeg-turbo
